patch_description: Split the complete-graph CZ entangler into three non-commuting stages separated by two single-axis mid-circuit mixers (RY after stage 1, RX after stage 2). This creates 3 entanglement stages vs the previous best's 2, increasing effective circuit depth and expressivity without adding parameters. The matchings are: stage 1 (M1-M3: 12 edges), RY_mid, stage 2 (M4-M5: 8 edges), RX_mid, stage 3 (M6-M7: 8 edges). All 28 K8 edges are still covered. Using orthogonal axes (RY then RX) for the two mid-circuit mixers maximizes the non-commutativity between stages. Total: 6 shared params per block × 6 blocks + 2 readout = 38 params (same as the best program).
